"""Bind the independent constructed-data review to source bytes before/after.

This executes review fixtures only. There are no scientific source paths,
allocation providers, or scientific report readers in the audit entry point.
"""
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=next(p for p in HERE.parents if (p/'src/lupine_discovery/decision_pool.py').is_file())
LANE=HERE.parent
PATHS=tuple(LANE/'scripts'/name for name in (
    'mpea_archive_report.py','mpea_archive_driver.py','mpea_archive_custody.py',
    'mpea_production_store.py','mpea_fixture_driver.py','mpea_study_flow.py',
    'mpea_target_custody.py','mpea_stage_store.py'))+tuple(ROOT/'scripts'/name for name in (
    'mpea_study_report.py','mpea_study.py','mpea_features.py'))+tuple(ROOT/'src/lupine_discovery'/name for name in (
    'decision_pool.py','representation.py','core.py','evidence.py','serialization.py','replay.py'))+tuple(
    LANE/'review_production'/name for name in ('constructed_archive_case.py','test_production_store_review.py'))+tuple(
    HERE/name for name in ('test_public_bridge_review.py','test_public_bridge_boundaries.py','bridge-before-binding-fix.py','audit_public_bridge.py','README.md'))


def snapshot():
    return {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in PATHS}


def main():
    before=snapshot(); started=time.monotonic()
    command=[sys.executable,'-m','unittest','-v','test_public_bridge_review','test_public_bridge_boundaries']
    completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=HERE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False)
    elapsed=time.monotonic()-started; after=snapshot()
    log=HERE/'final-tests-v1.log'; log.write_bytes(completed.stdout)
    match=re.search(rb'Ran ([0-9]+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s',completed.stdout)
    changed=[name for name in before if before[name]!=after[name]]
    result={'schema':'lupine.review.mpea_public_bridge.v1',
        'status':'PASS' if completed.returncode==0 and not changed and match and int(match.group(1))==21 else 'FAIL',
        'scope':'Independent synthetic public bridge review; no real archive, targets, allocation or entropy accessed.',
        'command':command,'exit_code':completed.returncode,
        'tests':None if match is None else int(match.group(1)),
        'test_seconds':None if match is None else match.group(2).decode(),
        'wall_seconds':format(elapsed,'.6f'),'source_before':before,'source_after':after,'changed_sources':changed,
        'log':{'path':str(log.relative_to(ROOT)),'bytes':len(completed.stdout),'sha256':sha256(completed.stdout).hexdigest()},
        'controls':['actual sealed 960-run exact aggregate and policy/cap/sameK accounting',
            'unknown primary and empty secondary remain explicit; unavailable F/D have null margins/components',
            'early decoder and pre-model interruptions expose no usefulness verdict',
            'issued result and projection occurrence bindings; nested mutable aggregate drift rejected',
            'exact exclusive public publication; cross-attempt projection rejected',
            'source-free declared registered original/reproduction metadata preserve scientific identity',
            'operational usage changes content identity only',
            'reserved payload contains semantic vault identities, full identities remain in stage inputs',
            'byte-exact preserved pre-fix bridge still reproduces four original acceptance defects'],
        'limitations':['Constructed controls do not authenticate registration, exchangeability, endpoint semantics or physical truth.',
            'The original/reproduction registration control uses declared fingerprints with no actual source read.',
            'In-process issuance guards prevent ordinary object mixups; they are not a sandbox against hostile Python.',
            'Full production worker, authority, allocation and OS custody controls are reviewed in separate lanes.']}
    raw=(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
    output=HERE/'independent-review-v1.json';output.write_bytes(raw)
    print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'tests':result['tests'],'changed_sources':changed,
        'receipt_sha256':sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'path':str(output.relative_to(ROOT))},sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if result['status']=='PASS' else 1


if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
